It does not specifically address the exclusion of institutional data from training or the provision of an opt-out mechanism for such data.

Article 13 of the EU AI Act pertains to transparency obligations for deployers of certain AI systems, such as providing information to users. It does not contain provisions related to the training data of AI models or the opt-out of institutional data.

Article 25(4) of the EU AI Act concerns the obligations of providers of high-risk AI systems to implement a quality management system. This article does not address the specific issue of excluding institutional data from training or providing an opt-out mechanism.
